actions: Fresh browser context at 540x960; localStorage cleared before startup.
Arrow-key movement from the beach start to the nearshore fishing net.
Arrow-key movement carrying fresh fish to the compatible fish ice tray.
Arrow-key movement to the checkout counter; the active order was completed by the normal player route.
Arrow-key movement away from the counter and back to collect the cash pile; repeated for a second order.
Normal movement through construction settlement, then click the visible next-market choice 珊瑚湾市场 to continue.

transitions.name: startup-to-harvest
transitions.evidence: Fresh 540x960 startup showed the beach shop and mission to collect from the nearshore net; cycle-02 reached the net and the mission changed to the fish ice tray.

transitions.name: harvest-to-shelf-deposit
transitions.evidence: Normal Arrow-key movement reached the fish ice tray; cycle-03 showed the active order card with 鲜鱼, 路线·鲜鱼冰盘, status 排队待结算, and shelf stock 1.

transitions.name: queue-to-packing
transitions.evidence: Cycle-04 showed the same active order card with status 打包中 and toast 打包中：正在封装货品. The raw watcher listed only the earlier queue event because its 7-second observation window ended before the transient packing event; the screenshot and phase summary show the player-visible branch.

transitions.name: packing-to-cash-pile
transitions.evidence: Cycle-04 showed 柜台现金 2/4 while packing completed, and cycle-05 showed the player away/back with cash collected and 贝壳币 8. The second cycle repeated this at cycles 07-09.

transitions.name: construction-to-settlement
transitions.evidence: Cycle-10 showed the natural settlement after construction completion, with the next-market panel and two visible original route choices 珊瑚湾市场 and 月潮码头.

transitions.name: settlement-to-next-market
transitions.evidence: Cycle-11 followed a normal click on 珊瑚湾市场 and returned to the operating HUD; the raw trace phase controls/continue records settlementHidden changing from false to true.
